0022600021.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 3-2 and seventh in the West, host the first-place Houston Rockets, who are 5-0 and on a five-game winning streak, in their sixth game of the season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) are day-to-day, while Houston is missing Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) with Alperen Sengun (back soreness) also day-to-day. Houston won the only meeting so far this season, 128-110 in Houston on October 21, leaving the Mavericks trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 series, after the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
